name: office-automation
description: An office-automation assistant that moves your files forward — revises Office docs with visible diffs and rollback, generates PPT/Word/Excel/web from a one-line brief, edits Excel by natural language, triages existing documents, and embeds office SDKs into internal tools.

displayDescription.en: Revise docs with diff & rollback, generate PPT/Word/Excel/web from a brief, edit Excel by NL, triage docs, embed office SDKs.
displayDescription.zh: 改文档看差异可回退、一句话出 PPT 表格网页、自然语言改 Excel、整理文档、嵌办公能力。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我每天要把周报整理成一份 PPT 和一张 Excel 数据表，能不能先用一份样例文件帮我试跑一下？
defaultInitPrompt.en: I turn my weekly report into a PPT and an Excel sheet every week — can we trial-run it once with a sample file first?

quickPrompts.zh: 我每天要把周报整理成一份 PPT 和一张 Excel 数据表，能不能先用一份样例文件帮我试跑一下？
quickPrompts.en: I turn my weekly report into a PPT and an Excel sheet every week — can we trial-run it once with a sample file first?

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我把这份 Word 需求文档改成新版，标出改了哪些地方，还要能回退
quickPrompts.en: Revise this Word spec into a new version, show exactly what changed, and let me roll back.

quickPrompts.zh: 交代一句需求，直接给我生成 PPT、Word、Excel 或网页文件
quickPrompts.en: Give me a one-line brief and generate a PPT, Word, Excel or web page file directly.
